worldcombat.skill.esperwing.summary: Gather aura into a pair of wings that beat one after another: the left wing sweeps the left half-fan first, then the right wing sweeps the right half-fan, dealing special damage to every foe caught with a higher critical chance. Only after the second wing lands does the user's Speed rise and a lingering aura remain. An empty beat still boosts.
The two wings sweep the two front half-fans in turn, dealing about %1$s special damage to each foe caught (each target is hit at most once) and landing critical hits more often.
The wings span %1$s blocks and spread %2$s degrees to each side; an empty beat still advances and boosts.
Once the second wing lands it raises the user's Speed by %1$s stage(s) and leaves a %2$s aura on the user; while the aura lingers a companion will not beat its wings again.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.stance.flap: Beat form: a heavier single hit, at a narrower arc and a shorter aura.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.stance.glide: Glide form: a wider arc and a longer aura, at a lighter single hit.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.growth.0: From level %1$s the aura blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.growth.1: From level %1$s the aura blade rises to %2$s, the arc opens to %3$s degrees and the span reaches %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.use.0: Gather aura and beat the two wings forward in turn
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.use.1: Cut the front in two beats, each target hit at most once
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.use.2: Lay down a Speed stage after the second wing lands
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.preference.f: On (beat): 112% power, at an arc narrowed to x0.7 and an aura shortened to x0.8. Off (glide): arc x1.4 and aura x1.3, at 90% power.
worldcombat.skill.esperwing.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of beating its wings; larger values open from further out and lay down Speed sooner.

On: while not yet boosted, the move is treated as an attack plus a Speed set-up and its priority rises above the shared attack order. Off: it ranks as an ordinary melee strike until pressed. Either way, threats on both sides in front raise it, since the two wings cover both sides.
